segments.name: Clinical-stage biotechnology
segments.description: Develops clinical-stage product candidates that reprogram the innate immune system to treat inflammatory, neurodegenerative and oncologic diseases.
segments.evidence: INmune Bio is a clinical-stage biotechnology company dedicated to developing and commercializing a pipeline of product candidates designed to reprogram the innate immune system.

revenueModel.text: The company is clinical-stage and has no approved products; it was compensated for supplying CORDStrom as an investigational medical product for a trial.
revenueModel.evidence: INmune Bio was compensated for CORDStrom used in the trial and was not a sponsor of the MissionEB study.
